Umbrella of keratinization disorders defined by persistent erythematous hyperkeratotic plaques; systemic manifestations are subtype-specific.

Copper-overload disorder causing hepatocyte necrosis, fibrosis and cirrhosis; urinary copper elevation does not establish kidney damage.
